concept: Leading without needing to be the one who's always right or always in the spotlight
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Lao Tzu's servant-leadership tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic leadership scenario (team, family, community) where the adult could either take center stage or empower others to shine
exercise.reflection_prompt: What does effective leadership look like when it's not about being the center of attention?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one specific way to redirect credit or visibility toward someone else on their team

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific, concrete action, not just a general leadership philosophy
